infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PU Transit Driver shows this bus’s position to Parul University students and staff during a trip you start. Sharing stops when you end the trip.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PU Transit Driver shares this bus’s live position with Parul University students and staff during a trip you start, including with the screen off or the app in the background. Sharing stops when you end the trip.
